body:
If a batch runs the same command twice (for example `check` twice), `board.failed_section` always uses the first `==== solace <command> ====` section, even when the second one failed. So the failed-step line from `board.failed_step_line` can show the first run's output instead of the failure.

This is rare. Matching the section against the failed command's position in the batch would fix it.

## Done when
- When a batch repeats a command and a later copy fails, the failed-step line shows that copy's error.
- A single command, or a batch with no repeats, behaves as today.
- A test covers a batch that runs the same command twice where the second one fails.
title: runs: failed step finds the right section
